instruction: A clean, high-contrast studio photograph captures a full shot of a minimalist white studio with a seamless white floor. On the left, the performer in the white hooded outfit (R2) leans forward with arms outstretched, facing away from the camera. On the right, the performer in the black hooded outfit (R1) crouches slightly, facing left with arms bent in a dynamic, defensive pose. The two performers engage in a dynamic, non-contact dance movement, oriented toward each other. Bright, diffused overhead lighting casts soft shadows on the floor, maintaining a clean, high-key color palette.

R2 performs the forward-leaning, arms-outstretched movement while R1 holds the crouched defensive stance

R1 and R2 perform a dynamic non-contact dance movement oriented toward each other
